title: Eala looks to carry renewed confidence into clash with world No. 13 Shnaider
summary: Alex Eala seeks to build on her dominant Ningbo opener as she faces world No. 13 Diana Shnaider in the Round of 16 on Wednesday, Oct. 21, with a quarterfinal berth at stake.
